alice: Heads-up — Tundra private VPC maintenance window scheduled Fri 2026-03-20 02:00-03:00 UTC. This is a non-prod->prod cutover for customer Tundra (on-prem network handoff). Need: deploy owner, smoke lead, rollback owner, and someone to watch networking. PRs that touch runtime must be merged by Thu 23:00 UTC. :calendar: 
ben: I can own the deploy. I’ll be on the zoom and have terminal access. :rocket:
carmen: I’ll own smoke tests and health checks. Planning a quick checklist (see below).
teresa: I’ll be rollback owner and have the rollback playbook ready. Will validate DB snapshot availability before the window.
sam: I’ll monitor infra alerts and be oncall for routing/firewall issues. Add me to the zoom invite.
alice: Thanks — pairing notes: ben = deploy lead, carmen = smoke, teresa = rollback, sam = oncall. @deploy-bot can you reserve the window and post the scheduled job?
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance reserved: Tundra VPC cutover — 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z for 60 minutes. Notifying stakeholders.
ben: Deploy plan (high level):
1) freeze traffic to app-nodes behind nginx via lb weight -> 0
2) apply infra change (BGP peer update from customer side)
3) deploy runtime binary (image tag: release-2026-03-18-457) to daemonset on cluster-tundra-prod
4) run DB migration v20260318-02 (non-blocking; runs < 30s)
5) incrementally shift traffic back and verify.
carmen: Smoke checklist (short):
- HTTP 200 on /health for main service
- sample generation latency < 200ms for 128-token request
- KV cache hit rate > 90% for prefix tests
- embeddings worker queue length < 5
- background workers running (systemctl status redwood-worker)
Commands I’ll run:
```bash
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY' https://tundra-api.internal/health
timeout 5s python tools/sample_latency.py --host tundra-api.internal --tokens 128
# quick kv check
curl -sS https://tundra-api.internal/internal/kv/status | jq .hit_rate
```
teresa: Rollback plan notes:
- snapshot tag: tundra-precutover-20260320-01 (verify exists)
- rollback steps: revert image to release-2026-03-15-stable, reapply old BGP config, restore snapshot if migration applied.
- I'll keep the rollback playbook at /runbooks/tundra-rollback.md and signal `ROLLBACK` in zoom chat if needed.
ben: Two quick callouts: PR #4589 (runtime config change) needs a final LGTM, and PR #4591 (env var tweak) should be merged by Thu 23:00. Carmen please re-run the small perf tests after merge.
alice: @carmen can you add the smoke matrix to the ticket? I’ll update the customer-facing maintenance note with timings.
carmen: Added matrix to ticket RDW-1342. Quick note — for the latency test use `--concurrency 2` to emulate production traffic.
sam: I added the zoom invite: https://zoom.redwood.ai/j/123456789 (recording off). I’ll also have a network engineer on standby in case BGP adj takes longer.
ben: On the day-of run order (short):
- T-30m: final go/no-go (all participants present)
- T-10m: freeze merges for customer repo + disable auto-scaling
- T0: apply infra changes
- T+5m: deploy images to 25% nodes, run smoke
- T+20m: if green, roll to 100%
- T+30m: monitoring window, then handoff to customer success
alice: Small ops constraints: keep window to 60m. If we need >60m escalate to me and product.
teresa: Confirmed snapshot exists. I’ll keep a terminal open for immediate rollback.
ben: LGTM on plan. I’ll post the final runbook in the channel Thu 22:00 UTC.
carmen: Quick ask — bring the flamegraph profiler up if latency spikes; `pgrep -f profiler || systemctl start profiler`.
alice: Thanks everyone. If any last-minute PR issues ping me directly. :thumbsup:
ben: copy. See you on Fri.
